name: enable_module
label: Enable Module
help_text: When off, the module outputs nothing. Use to keep the module in the page flow but hide it from view.

name: custom_id
label: Custom ID
help_text: Replaces the auto-generated module ID used in HTML and for CSS/JS targeting. Leave blank to use the default.

name: custom_classes
label: Custom Classes
help_text: Additional CSS classes for styling this module.

children.name: heading_text
children.label: Heading
children.help_text: Main heading text. Plain text or raw HTML tags (e.g. strong, em, span).

children.name: heading_size
children.label: Size
children.help_text: HTML heading level (h1–h6). Use Display Size to control how large it looks.

children.name: heading_display_size
children.label: Display Size
children.help_text: Controls how large the heading appears. Independent of the HTML heading level (Size).

children.name: heading_color
children.label: Color
children.help_text: Theme or custom color for this heading. Auto uses Text Color from Content Colors for this grouping.

children.name: heading_color_custom
children.label: Custom Color
children.help_text: Hex color with opacity when Color is set to Custom.

children.name: heading_align
children.label: Align
children.help_text: Horizontal alignment from 992px and up (LG and XL together). Auto uses Content Area Settings Text Alignment for this grouping. Override Tablet/Mobile on this heading to set those breakpoints independently.

children.name: heading_md_text_align_override
children.label: Override Text Alignment (Tablet)
children.help_text: Enable to set a different text alignment for this breakpoint.

children.name: heading_md_text_align
children.label: Text Alignment (Tablet)
children.help_text: Text alignment when Override Text Alignment (Tablet) is enabled.

children.name: heading_sm_text_align_override
children.label: Override Text Alignment (Mobile)
children.help_text: Enable to set a different text alignment for this breakpoint.

children.name: heading_sm_text_align
children.label: Text Alignment (Mobile)
children.help_text: Text alignment when Override Text Alignment (Mobile) is enabled.

children.name: heading_md_display_size_override
children.label: Override Tablet Display Size
children.help_text: Enable to set a custom display size for this breakpoint.

children.name: heading_md_display_size
children.label: Tablet Display Size
children.help_text: Display size when Override Tablet Display Size is enabled.

children.name: heading_sm_display_size_override
children.label: Override Mobile Display Size
children.help_text: Enable to set a custom display size for this breakpoint.

children.name: heading_sm_display_size
children.label: Mobile Display Size
children.help_text: Display size when Override Mobile Display Size is enabled.

children.name: heading_padding_override
children.label: Override Padding
children.help_text: Enable to override the theme's default padding for this heading. When enabled, you can set custom top and bottom padding values. When disabled, padding is controlled by the theme's display size setting.

children.name: heading_padding_top
children.label: Padding Top (px)
children.help_text: Top padding in pixels when Override Padding is enabled.

children.name: heading_padding_bottom
children.label: Padding Bottom (px)
children.help_text: Bottom padding in pixels when Override Padding is enabled.

children.name: heading_class
children.label: CSS Class
children.help_text: Additional CSS class(es) for this element. Space-separated.

default.heading_text: Outer / Inner paint, Aurora, and CTAs

name: content_area
label: Content Area
default: SW Hero is the Smithworks banner module: headings, rich text, and buttons over Module Outer and Inner backgrounds. This sample uses a light Outer fill with an animated Aurora overlay—optional color wash with motion (not Glass/Grain/Pattern Effect).

name: content_style
label: Content style
help_text: Large = larger intro text (balanced or full-width); Small = smaller/secondary; Blockquote = quote/callout.

name: cta_alignment
label: Button Alignment
help_text: Horizontal alignment of the buttons (left, center, or right).

name: cta_buttons_margin_top
label: Space Above Buttons (px)
help_text: Vertical space between the content above and this button row. Applies on all breakpoints when at least one button is shown. Does not replace per-button Override Button Margins.

children.name: add_icon
children.label: Add Icon
children.help_text: Enable to add a Font Awesome icon to the button.

children.name: purpose
children.label: Purpose
children.help_text: The purpose of the icon, used for accessibility. If set to decorative, an additional attribute of aria-hidden="true" will be added to the icon.

children.name: spacing
children.label: Icon Spacing (px)
children.help_text: Gap between the icon and the button text. Applies on the side the icon is on (Left or Right).

children.name: hide_text
children.label: Hide Button Text
children.help_text: For Simple Link with an icon: hide the label visually so the icon stands alone. The button text stays in the HTML for screen readers.

children.name: override_margins
children.label: Override Button Margins
children.help_text: Set left and right margin for this button only. Other buttons are unchanged unless they also have Override on. Does not replace first-item left or last-item right layout spacing.

children.name: margin_left
children.label: Margin Left (px)
children.help_text: Space before this button only. Ignored on the first button in the row. Independent of this button’s Margin Right and of other buttons.

children.name: margin_right
children.label: Margin Right (px)
children.help_text: Space after this button only. Ignored on the last button in the row. Independent of this button’s Margin Left and of other buttons.

name: background_video_settings
label: Module Background Video
help_text: Used when Style → Module Inner Background Options is Video. Choose the video source (HubSpot Video, File Manager, or embed) and poster here. Overlay and base color stay in Style.

children.name: video_source_type
children.label: Video Type
children.help_text: Choose HubSpot Video (Marketing > Video), a video from the File Manager, or an external embed.

children.name: hubspot_video
children.label: HubSpot Video
children.help_text: Select a video from Marketing > Video.

children.name: video_file
children.label: Video from files
children.help_text: Select a video from the File Manager. Shown as background; autoplay muted and loop.

children.name: embed_field
children.label: External Embed
children.help_text: Embed a video from YouTube, Vimeo, or other external sources.

children.name: poster_image
children.label: Poster image
children.help_text: Shown before the video loads and as fallback if video fails.

name: inner_pattern_custom_svg_code
label: Module Inner Pattern — Custom SVG Code
help_text: Paste the full <svg>…</svg> markup (not a file). Used when Style → Module Inner → Pattern Style is Custom SVG. Color Mode, Pattern Size, Blend, and Scale stay in Style.
inline_help_text: Used when Style → Module Inner → Pattern Style is Custom SVG.

name: text_box_pattern_custom_svg_code
label: Text Box Pattern — Custom SVG Code
help_text: Paste the full <svg>…</svg> markup (not a file). Used when Style → Text Box → Pattern Style is Custom SVG. Color Mode, Pattern Size, Blend, and Scale stay in Style.
inline_help_text: Used when Style → Text Box → Pattern Style is Custom SVG.

name: outer_aurora_custom_svg_code
label: Module Outer Aurora — Custom SVG Code
help_text: Paste the full <svg>…</svg> markup (not a file). Opaque shapes on a transparent background, include a viewBox, omit the XML header. One silhouette is used for all three stamps. Aurora Colors paint that shape. Edge blur, Scale, Blend, and Motion stay in Style.
inline_help_text: Used when Style → Module Outer → Blob style is Custom SVG.

name: outer_svg_overlay_code
label: Module Outer SVG Overlay — SVG Code
help_text: Paste the full <svg>…</svg> markup (not a file). Include a viewBox, omit the XML header. Ungroup shapes so each square or path can appear and twinkle on its own. A local sample is images/sw-defaults/sw-hero-svg-overlay-grid.svg. Color, Animation, Position, and Scale stay in Style → SVG Overlay.
inline_help_text: Used when Style → Module Outer → SVG Overlay is enabled. Ungrouped shapes animate best.

name: outer_animated_custom_svg_code
label: Module Outer Animated — Custom SVG Code
help_text: Not used in the Artwork dropdown (Wave 1–5 only). If this field is shown again: paste full <svg>…</svg> of open stroked paths, fill none, include viewBox, omit the XML header. Do not Outline Stroke or use an opacity mask. Per-path opacity is supported. Gradients, filters, and compound fills are ignored. Motion Roll/Ripple samples strokes (capped).
inline_help_text: Unused while Artwork is Wave 1–5. Ribbon SVG format: open strokes, fill none, no Expand.

name: inner_aurora_custom_svg_code
label: Module Inner Aurora — Custom SVG Code
help_text: Paste the full <svg>…</svg> markup (not a file). Opaque shapes on a transparent background, include a viewBox, omit the XML header. One silhouette is used for all three stamps. Aurora Colors paint that shape. Edge blur, Scale, Blend, and Motion stay in Style.
inline_help_text: Used when Style → Module Inner → Blob style is Custom SVG.

children.name: module_settings
children.label: Module Settings
children.help_text: Module Outer Spacing and Max Module Outer Width (full-bleed band). Module Inner Spacing and Max Module Inner Width (hero surface). Module height cascades from XL unless overridden.

children.name: spacing
children.label: Module Outer Spacing
children.help_text: Margins and padding for the outer module band (full-width area). Use Module Inner Spacing for space inside the hero content column.

children.name: outer_background_width
children.label: Max Module Outer Width
children.help_text: Max width of the outer row behind the module (theme containers, Full Width, or Custom px). When not Full Width: limits the centered column together with Max Module Inner Width; for outer Image, limits the image band. Theme color, Custom color, Gradient, and Divider still paint the full row; this setting caps content (and the image band).

children.name: outer_background_width_custom
children.label: Outer background width (px)
children.help_text: Custom max width when Custom is selected above (600–2400).

children.name: inner_spacing
children.label: Module Inner Spacing
children.help_text: Padding/margin inside the hero surface (inside the outer band). Text Box Padding still controls the content box.

children.name: max_module_width
children.label: Max Module Inner Width
children.help_text: Max width of the hero inner surface / content column. Default uses theme container. Full Width spans the screen.

children.name: max_module_width_custom
children.label: Max Module Inner Width (px)
children.help_text: Custom max width in pixels when Custom is selected above.

children.name: module_height_xl_group
children.label: XL Module Height
children.help_text: Height settings for Extra Large screens. Cascades to smaller breakpoints unless overridden.

children.name: module_height_xl_mode
children.label: Minimum Height
children.help_text: Default: no minimum height (content dictates height). Custom Height: set a pixel value. Full Screen: 100vh minus header.

children.name: module_height_xl
children.label: Height (px)
children.help_text: Minimum height in pixels. Cascades to smaller breakpoints unless overridden.

children.name: vertical_align_xl
children.label: Vertical Alignment
children.help_text: Vertical alignment of content within the module at XL breakpoint.

children.name: module_height_lg_group
children.label: Override Desktop Height
children.help_text: Use a different height for Desktop. Enable the override toggle, then configure below.

children.name: override_lg_module_height
children.label: Override
children.help_text: Enable to use a different height for this breakpoint.

children.name: module_height_lg
children.label: Height (px)
children.help_text: Minimum height in pixels for this breakpoint.

children.name: vertical_align_lg
children.label: Vertical Alignment
children.help_text: Vertical alignment for this breakpoint. Inherit uses XL value.

children.name: module_height_md_group
children.label: Override Tablet Height
children.help_text: Use a different height for Tablet. Enable the override toggle, then configure below.

children.name: override_md_module_height
children.label: Override
children.help_text: Enable to use a different height for this breakpoint.

children.label: Height (px)
children.help_text: Minimum height in pixels for this breakpoint.

children.name: vertical_align_md
children.label: Vertical Alignment
children.help_text: Vertical alignment for this breakpoint. Inherit uses larger breakpoint value.

children.name: module_height_sm_group
children.label: Override Mobile Height
children.help_text: Use a different height for Mobile. Enable the override toggle, then configure below.

children.name: override_sm_module_height
children.label: Override
children.help_text: Enable to use a different height for this breakpoint.

children.name: module_height_sm
children.label: Height (px)
children.help_text: Minimum height in pixels for this breakpoint.

children.name: vertical_align_sm
children.label: Vertical Alignment
children.help_text: Vertical alignment for this breakpoint. Inherit uses larger breakpoint value.

children.name: module_background_settings
children.label: Module Background Settings
children.help_text: Two layers: Module Outer is the full-width band behind the hero; Module Inner is the hero surface. Work top to bottom — Outer fill and borders, then Inner fill, then Inner border. Effect on Inner overlays Outer; it does not add an Inner photo.

children.name: outer_background_option
children.label: Module Outer Background Options
children.help_text: Paints the full-width band behind the hero surface. None = no Outer layer. Theme Color, Custom Color, Gradient, and Divided/Split fill the full row (Divided/Split = two fills split by one straight segment). Image uses the XL → Desktop/Tablet/Mobile cascade on this Outer layer only (no video). An Outer photo is not the Inner photo — those are separate options. Animated paints WebGL Roll or Ripple on this Outer band only (not Inner). Outer Aurora Overlay is hidden while Animated is selected. Default remains None.

children.name: outer_animated
children.label: Animated
children.help_text: Roll or Ripple motion on this Outer band only (not Inner). Wave 1–5 are ribbon drawings — not the Ripple engine. Phone and reduced-motion show the SVG. Outer Aurora Overlay is hidden.

children.name: motion
children.label: Motion
children.help_text: Roll = cylindrical pitch. Ripple = left-to-right motion. This is the engine, not Artwork Wave 1–5.
children.inline_help_text: Engine only — not the Artwork name.

children.name: art
children.label: Artwork
children.help_text: Each option is a ribbon drawing. Theme or Custom color recolors the lines. Fade comes from each line’s opacity in the file. Gradients in the SVG are ignored.
children.inline_help_text: Stroke ribbons. Opacity fades; gradients are ignored.

children.name: color_mode
children.label: Artwork color
children.help_text: Recolors the ribbon strokes. Per-line opacity from the SVG is kept. Gradients in the file are ignored.

children.name: custom_color_mode
children.label: Custom SVG color mode
children.help_text: Only if Artwork Custom SVG is restored. Use SVG colors keeps markup hues. Theme or Custom recolors strokes. Gradients are ignored.

children.name: theme_color
children.label: Theme Color
children.help_text: Same tokens as Module Outer Theme Color. No Custom choice here — use Custom Color mode.

children.name: custom_color
children.label: Custom Color
children.help_text: Stroke color when Artwork color is Custom Color. Per-line opacity from the SVG stays.

children.name: rotate
children.label: Rotate (deg)
children.help_text: Rotate around the artwork center. Roll and Ripple stay in art space, so the axis turns with the drawing. Use Scale or Keep full bleed if edges show after rotate.

children.name: pos_x
children.label: Position X (%)
children.help_text: Horizontal position of the rotated artwork. 50 is center of the Outer band.

children.name: pos_y
children.label: Position Y (%)
children.help_text: Vertical position of the rotated artwork. 50 is center of the Outer band.

children.name: scale_x
children.label: Scale X (%)
children.help_text: Horizontal scale of the transformed artwork. Raise if a side of the Outer band shows after rotate or nudge.

children.name: scale_y
children.label: Scale Y (%)
children.help_text: Vertical scale of the transformed artwork. Independent of Scale X.

children.name: cover
children.label: Keep full bleed
children.help_text: On: extra scale so rotation does not show empty corners. Off: only Scale X/Y. Default on.

children.name: roll_speed
children.label: Pitch speed
children.help_text: How fast Roll pitches.

children.name: wave_speed
children.label: Speed
children.help_text: How fast Ripple moves left to right.

children.name: wave_amp
children.label: Amplitude
children.help_text: How far Ripple moves the lines.

children.name: wave_lag
children.label: Line lag
children.help_text: Delay between lines so they do not all move in lockstep.

children.name: outer_background_image_xl_group
children.label: Module Outer: XL Background Image
children.help_text: Background image settings for XL screens (≥1200px). Cascades to smaller breakpoints unless overridden.

children.name: background_color_overlay_xl
children.label: Background Color Overlay
children.help_text: Color overlay on top of the Outer background image. Does not affect the Inner photo.

children.name: background_base_color_xl
children.label: Background Base Color
children.help_text: Solid color behind the background image (fallback or for transparent areas).

children.name: background_image_xl
children.label: Background Image
children.help_text: Fallback image for smaller breakpoints if not overridden. For retina quality: use 2× the display width (about 2400px at 1200px). Height can match your section—from very short to several hundred pixels—and Background Position helps with focal point.

children.name: background_position_xl
children.label: Background Position
children.help_text: Anchor point for the background image at this breakpoint.

children.name: background_repeat_xl
children.label: Background Repeat
children.help_text: Control how the background image repeats at this breakpoint.

children.name: hero_background_size
children.label: Background Size
children.help_text: Cover, Contain, Stretch to Fill, or Natural Size.

children.name: outer_background_image_lg_group
children.label: Module Outer: Override Desktop Background Image
children.help_text: Use a different background image for 992px–1199px (LG). Enable the override toggle, then configure image and styles below.

children.name: override_lg_background_image
children.label: Module Outer: Override
children.help_text: Enable to use a different image for this breakpoint. Leave the image empty to hide it here; hide continues to smaller breakpoints until another override sets a file. On module outer/inner backgrounds, base color and overlay still apply.

children.name: background_color_overlay_lg
children.label: Background Color Overlay
children.help_text: Color overlay on top of the Outer background image at this breakpoint. Does not affect the Inner photo.

children.name: background_base_color_lg
children.label: Background Base Color
children.help_text: Solid color behind the background image at this breakpoint.

children.name: background_image_lg
children.label: Background Image
children.help_text: Leave empty to hide at this breakpoint (and smaller until another override sets a file). Image when override enabled. For retina quality: use 2× the display width; height can match your section, short to tall.

children.name: background_position_lg
children.label: Background Position
children.help_text: Anchor point for the background image at this breakpoint.

children.name: background_repeat_lg
children.label: Background Repeat
children.help_text: Control how the background image repeats at this breakpoint.

children.name: hero_background_size_lg
children.label: Background Size
children.help_text: Cover, Contain, Stretch to Fill, or Natural Size.

children.label: Module Outer: Override Tablet Background Image
children.help_text: Use a different background image for 768px–991px (MD). Enable the override toggle, then configure image and styles below.

children.name: override_md_background_image
children.label: Module Outer: Override
children.help_text: Enable to use a different image for this breakpoint. Leave the image empty to hide it here; hide continues to smaller breakpoints until another override sets a file. On module outer/inner backgrounds, base color and overlay still apply.

children.name: background_color_overlay_md
children.label: Background Color Overlay
children.help_text: Color overlay on top of the Outer background image at this breakpoint. Does not affect the Inner photo.

children.name: background_base_color_md

children.help_text: Solid color behind the background image at this breakpoint.

children.name: background_image_md
children.label: Background Image

children.help_text: Anchor point for the background image at this breakpoint.

children.name: background_repeat_md
children.label: Background Repeat
children.help_text: Control how the background image repeats at this breakpoint.

children.name: hero_background_size_md
children.label: Background Size
children.help_text: Cover, Contain, Stretch to Fill, or Natural Size.

children.name: outer_background_image_sm_group
children.label: Module Outer: Override Mobile Background Image
children.help_text: Use a different background image for ≤767px (SM). Enable the override toggle, then configure image and styles below.

children.name: override_sm_background_image
children.label: Module Outer: Override
children.help_text: Enable to use a different image for this breakpoint. Leave the image empty to hide it here; hide continues to smaller breakpoints until another override sets a file. On module outer/inner backgrounds, base color and overlay still apply.

children.name: background_color_overlay_sm
children.label: Background Color Overlay
children.help_text: Color overlay on top of the Outer background image at this breakpoint. Does not affect the Inner photo.

children.name: background_base_color_sm
children.label: Background Base Color
children.help_text: Solid color behind the background image at this breakpoint.

children.name: background_image_sm
children.label: Background Image
children.help_text: Leave empty to hide at this breakpoint (and smaller until another override sets a file). Image when override enabled. For retina quality: use 2× the display width; height can match your section, short to tall.

children.help_text: Anchor point for the background image at this breakpoint.

children.name: background_repeat_sm
children.label: Background Repeat
children.help_text: Control how the background image repeats at this breakpoint.

children.name: hero_background_size_sm
children.label: Background Size
children.help_text: Cover, Contain, Stretch to Fill, or Natural Size.

children.name: outer_background_color
children.label: Module Outer: Theme Color
children.help_text: Choose a theme color for the outer backdrop. For a custom hex color with opacity, use Module Outer Background Options = Custom Color.

children.name: outer_background_color_custom
children.label: Module Outer: Custom Color
children.help_text: Legacy custom theme-color value retained for saved instances. For new custom outer colors, use Module Outer Background Options = Custom Color.

children.name: outer_background_custom
children.label: Module Outer: Background Color
children.help_text: Solid color with opacity when Background Option is Custom Color.

children.name: outer_background_gradient
children.label: Module Outer: Background Gradient
children.help_text: When Background Option is Gradient: direction and color stops for the full-row outer backdrop.

children.name: module_outer_divider_left_y_percent
children.label: Module Outer: Divider — left edge height (%)
children.help_text: Vertical position (0–100) of the line at the left edge of the full-width outer row.

children.name: module_outer_divider_right_y_percent
children.label: Module Outer: Divider — right edge height (%)
children.help_text: Vertical position (0–100) of the line at the right edge of the full-width row. One straight segment connects left and right.

children.name: module_outer_divider_color_top
children.label: Module Outer: Divider — top / above line
children.help_text: Fill color for the region above the split line (toward the top of the full-width row).

children.name: module_outer_divider_color_bottom
children.label: Module Outer: Divider — bottom / below line
children.help_text: Fill color for the region below the split line (toward the bottom of the full-width row).

children.name: outer_aurora
children.label: Outer Aurora Overlay
children.help_text: Optional color wash on top of this Outer fill (Theme Color, Custom Color, Gradient, or Image). Not Glass, Grain, or Pattern — those are Inner Effect Types. Hidden when Outer is None, Divided/Split, or Animated. Off by default.

children.name: enable
children.label: Enable Outer Aurora Overlay
children.help_text: Turn on a three-stamp color wash over this Outer fill. Off by default so existing heroes stay unchanged.

children.name: style
children.label: Blob style
children.help_text: Soft blobs are circles. Custom SVG uses one silhouette for all three stamps; Aurora Colors paint that shape. Edge blur, Scale, Blend, and Motion still apply.
children.inline_help_text: Custom SVG code is at the bottom of the Content tab: Module Outer Aurora — Custom SVG Code.

children.name: color_1
children.label: Aurora Color 1
children.help_text: Stamp 1 color. The percentage is that stamp’s strength (0% hides this stamp).

children.name: color_2
children.label: Aurora Color 2
children.help_text: Stamp 2 color. The percentage is that stamp’s strength (0% hides this stamp).

children.name: color_3
children.label: Aurora Color 3
children.help_text: Stamp 3 color. The percentage is that stamp’s strength (0% hides this stamp).

children.name: strength
children.label: Strength
children.help_text: Multiplies all three stamps. 50 is the default wash; 0 is off; 100 is full stamp strength.

children.name: edge_blur
children.label: Edge blur (px)
children.help_text: Gaussian blur of each hard stamp. 0 is a crisp edge. 20 softens the rim but the blob still reads as a shape. 120 dissolves it.
children.inline_help_text: 0 = hard edge. Higher = softer rim in and out.

children.name: scale
children.label: Scale (%)
children.help_text: Stamp size. 100 is default. Lower is smaller; higher is larger.

children.name: blend
children.label: Blend
children.help_text: How the wash mixes with this Outer fill. Normal keeps Aurora Color honest. Overlay and Soft Light sit on photos. Multiply darkens (good on light Color fills); Screen lightens.

children.name: motion
children.label: Motion
children.help_text: Slow drift of the stamps. On when Aurora is enabled. Turn off for a still wash. Live pages respect prefers-reduced-motion and stay still.

children.name: duration
children.label: Duration
children.help_text: How long one drift cycle takes. This is duration, not velocity: 8 seconds is faster; 30 seconds is slower.
children.inline_help_text: Seconds per cycle. Lower is faster.

children.name: outer_svg_overlay
children.label: SVG Overlay
children.help_text: Optional SVG on top of this Outer fill (Theme Color, Custom Color, Gradient, or Image). Hidden when Outer is None, Divided/Split, or Animated. Off by default. Paste SVG code in Content. Shapes keep their ratio; use Position, Scale, and Opacity to place them.

children.name: enable
children.label: Enable SVG Overlay
children.help_text: Show the pasted SVG on top of this Outer fill. Off by default so existing heroes stay unchanged.

children.name: color_mode
children.label: Overlay colors
children.help_text: Use colors from SVG keeps fills and strokes from the markup. Override paints every shape with one Theme or Custom color.
children.inline_help_text: SVG code is at the bottom of the Content tab: Module Outer SVG Overlay — SVG Code.

children.name: override_color_source
children.label: Override color
children.help_text: Theme Color uses a theme token. Custom Color is a one-off hex (and opacity).

children.name: theme_color
children.label: Theme Color
children.help_text: Same tokens as Module Outer Theme Color.

children.name: custom_color
children.label: Custom Color
children.help_text: One-off overlay color. Opacity is how strong the fill is.

children.name: animation
children.label: Animation
children.help_text: Appear randomly fades shapes in over Appear duration. Twinkle keeps a few shapes fading in and out. Appear randomly, then twinkle does both.

children.name: appear_duration
children.label: Appear duration (seconds)
children.help_text: How long it takes for all shapes to pop in. Each shape starts at a random time inside this window.

children.name: twinkle_speed
children.label: Twinkle speed
children.help_text: How often a new set fades off. Each set fades out, stays off for twice this interval (Slow/Medium = 2s, Fast = 1.5s), then fades back in. The next set starts while the last set is still off, so some squares stay dark.

children.name: position
children.label: Position
children.help_text: Where the SVG sits in the Outer band. The graphic keeps its ratio (never stretched). Custom (from edge) uses the offset fields below — same idea as Outer Image.

children.name: scale
children.label: Scale (%)
children.help_text: Size of the SVG relative to the Outer band. 100% fits the graphic inside the band without stretching. Use this if you need it larger or smaller after Position.

children.name: opacity
children.label: Opacity (%)
children.help_text: Transparency of the whole overlay layer. 100% is fully visible. Does not change the colors inside the SVG. Appear and twinkle still run on top of this.

children.name: disable
children.label: Disable SVG Overlay
children.help_text: Hide the overlay at specific viewports. Each toggle is independent — turning off MD does not turn off SM. All off by default so the overlay shows at every size. Useful when you also hide the Outer image at that size.

children.name: xl
children.label: XL
children.help_text: Hide the overlay on extra-large screens only. Other sizes stay visible unless you turn those off too. Handy when you also hide the Outer image at this size.

children.name: lg
children.label: LG
children.help_text: Hide the overlay on large screens only. Does not hide XL, tablet, or mobile — turn those off separately if you want them hidden too.

children.name: md
children.label: MD
children.help_text: Hide the overlay on tablet only. Does not hide other sizes — turn those off separately if you want them hidden too.

children.name: sm
children.label: SM
children.help_text: Hide the overlay on small and extra-small screens only. Does not hide tablet or larger — turn those off separately if you want them hidden too.

children.name: outer_border_style
children.label: Module Outer Border Style
children.help_text: Border style for the module outer band. Use None to remove the outer border.

children.name: outer_border_position
children.label: Module Outer Border Position
children.help_text: Choose whether the module outer border appears on the top, bottom, or both top and bottom edges.

children.name: outer_border_width
children.label: Module Outer Border Weight (px)
children.help_text: Border weight for the selected module outer border edge(s).

children.name: outer_border_color
children.label: Module Outer Border Color
children.help_text: Border color for the selected module outer border edge(s).

children.name: background_option
children.label: Module Inner Background Options
children.help_text: Paints the hero surface. None = no Inner fill (Outer or the section shows through — do not use Custom Color at 0% for that). Theme Color, Custom Color, Gradient, Image, and Video fill this Inner layer (opaque fills cover Outer). Effect does not fill Inner — Glass, Grain, or Pattern overlay whatever is behind Inner (usually Outer). Inner Image and Inner Effect cannot be on at the same time. To frost a photo, put the photo on Outer, then choose Effect here.

children.name: background_color
children.label: Theme Color
children.help_text: Choose a theme color. For a custom hex color, use Background Option = Custom Color instead.

children.name: background_color_custom
children.label: Custom Color
children.help_text: Hex color with opacity when Background Option is Custom Color.

children.name: background_image_xl_group
children.label: XL Background Image
children.help_text: Background image settings for XL screens (≥1200px). Cascades to smaller breakpoints unless overridden.

default.alt: Sample background photograph for module documentation

children.name: background_position_xl_custom_h_edge
children.label: Custom Horizontal Edge
children.help_text: Position from this horizontal edge.

children.name: background_position_xl_custom_v_edge
children.label: Custom Vertical Edge
children.help_text: Position from this vertical edge.

children.name: hero_background_size
children.label: Background Size
children.help_text: Cover, Contain, Stretch to Fill, or Natural Size.

children.name: override_lg_background_image
children.label: Override
children.help_text: Enable to use a different image for this breakpoint. Leave the image empty to hide it here; hide continues to smaller breakpoints until another override sets a file. On module outer/inner backgrounds, base color and overlay still apply.

children.name: background_image_lg
children.label: Desktop Background Image
children.help_text: Leave empty to hide at this breakpoint (and smaller until another override sets a file). Image when override enabled.

children.name: override_md_background_image
children.label: Override
children.help_text: Enable to use a different image for this breakpoint. Leave the image empty to hide it here; hide continues to smaller breakpoints until another override sets a file. On module outer/inner backgrounds, base color and overlay still apply.

children.name: background_image_md
children.label: Tablet Background Image
children.help_text: Leave empty to hide at this breakpoint (and smaller until another override sets a file). Image when override enabled.

children.name: override_sm_background_image
children.label: Override
children.help_text: Enable to use a different image for this breakpoint. Leave the image empty to hide it here; hide continues to smaller breakpoints until another override sets a file. On module outer/inner backgrounds, base color and overlay still apply.

children.name: background_image_sm
children.label: Mobile Background Image
children.help_text: Leave empty to hide at this breakpoint (and smaller until another override sets a file). Image when override enabled.

children.name: background_color_overlay_video
children.label: Background Color Overlay
children.help_text: Color overlay on top of the video. Shown when Background Option is Video.

children.name: background_base_color_video
children.label: Background Base Color
children.help_text: Solid color behind the video (fallback or before video loads). Shown when Background Option is Video.

children.name: video_autoplay
children.label: Autoplay
children.help_text: Start playing when the page loads (recommended for background video).

children.name: video_loop
children.label: Loop
children.help_text: Restart the video when it ends.

children.name: video_muted
children.label: Muted
children.help_text: Play without sound (required for autoplay in most browsers).

children.name: video_plays_inline
children.label: Plays inline
children.help_text: Play inline on mobile instead of fullscreen.

children.name: inner_aurora
children.label: Inner Aurora Overlay
children.help_text: Optional color wash on this Inner fill (Theme Color, Custom Color, Gradient, or Image). This is the Inner surface, not Outer Animated. Hidden when Inner is None, Video, or Effect. Off by default.

children.name: enable
children.label: Enable Inner Aurora Overlay
children.help_text: Turn on a three-stamp color wash over this Inner fill. Off by default so existing heroes stay unchanged.

children.name: blob_style
children.label: Blob style
children.help_text: Soft blobs are circles. Custom SVG uses one silhouette for all three stamps; Aurora Colors paint that shape. Edge blur, Scale, Blend, and Motion still apply.
children.inline_help_text: Custom SVG code is at the bottom of the Content tab: Module Inner Aurora — Custom SVG Code.

children.name: color_1
children.label: Aurora Color 1
children.help_text: Stamp 1 color. The percentage is that stamp’s strength (0% hides this stamp).

children.name: color_2
children.label: Aurora Color 2
children.help_text: Stamp 2 color. The percentage is that stamp’s strength (0% hides this stamp).

children.name: color_3
children.label: Aurora Color 3
children.help_text: Stamp 3 color. The percentage is that stamp’s strength (0% hides this stamp).

children.name: strength
children.label: Strength
children.help_text: Multiplies all three stamps. 50 is the default wash; 0 is off; 100 is full stamp strength.

children.name: edge_blur
children.label: Edge blur (px)
children.help_text: Gaussian blur of each hard stamp. 0 is a crisp edge. 20 softens the rim but the blob still reads as a shape. 120 dissolves it.
children.inline_help_text: 0 = hard edge. Higher = softer rim in and out.

children.name: scale
children.label: Scale (%)
children.help_text: Stamp size. 100 is default. Lower is smaller; higher is larger.

children.name: blend
children.label: Blend
children.help_text: How the wash mixes with this Inner fill. Normal keeps Aurora Color honest. Overlay and Soft Light sit on photos. Multiply darkens (good on light Color fills); Screen lightens.

children.name: motion
children.label: Motion
children.help_text: Slow drift of the stamps. On when Aurora is enabled. Turn off for a still wash. Live pages respect prefers-reduced-motion and stay still.

children.name: duration
children.label: Duration
children.help_text: How long one drift cycle takes. This is duration, not velocity: 8 seconds is faster; 30 seconds is slower.
children.inline_help_text: Seconds per cycle. Lower is faster.

children.name: inner_effect_type
children.label: Effect Type
children.help_text: Glass, Grain, or Pattern. Inner stays an overlay: it does not add an Inner photo, video, color, or gradient. What shows through is the layer behind Inner (usually Module Outer).
children.inline_help_text: Overlays the layer behind Inner. Does not add an Inner photo.

children.name: inner_glass
children.label: Glass
children.help_text: Frost over the layer behind Inner: blur, tint (any hex + opacity), saturate, and a glass edge. Full-panel on Module Inner. While Effect is on, the glass edge replaces Module Inner Border stroke. Corner radius stays on Override Module Inner Border.

children.name: blur
children.label: Glass Blur (px)
children.help_text: Backdrop blur amount. Keep modest for performance.

children.name: fill
children.label: Glass Fill
children.help_text: Translucent tint on the frosted inner surface. Opacity is the main how-glassy lever.

children.name: saturate
children.label: Glass Saturate (%)
children.help_text: Color saturation of the blurred layer behind the glass. 100 is none; 160 is a typical frost.

children.name: border
children.label: Glass Border Color
children.help_text: Light edge on the frosted panel. Used instead of Module Inner Border stroke while Effect is on. Radius is unchanged — still Override Module Inner Border.

children.name: border_width
children.label: Glass Border Weight (px)
children.help_text: Width of the glass edge. 0 = no edge.

children.name: inner_grain
children.label: Grain
children.help_text: Film-grain speckle over the layer behind Inner (usually Module Outer). Does not add an Inner photo. Grain Color percentage is speckle strength. Grain Background plus Grain Color for tinted combos (for example a blue wash with yellow speckle).

children.name: background
children.label: Grain Background
children.help_text: Tint behind the speckle. Transparent by default so the layer behind Inner shows through (usually Module Outer).

children.name: grain_color
children.label: Grain Color
children.help_text: Speckle hue and strength. The color percentage is how visible the grain is (100% = strongest; 0% = none).

children.name: blend
children.label: Grain Blend
children.help_text: How the speckle mixes with the layer below. Normal keeps Grain Color honest. Overlay and Soft Light are film-on-photo. Multiply only darkens; Screen only lightens.

children.name: density
children.label: Grain Density
children.help_text: How many specks per area. Speckle size stays with Grain Scale. Sparse = gappier; Dense = packed.

children.name: scale
children.label: Grain Scale (%)
children.help_text: Speckle size. 100 is default. Lower = finer (smaller specks); higher = coarser (larger specks).

children.name: inner_pattern
children.label: Pattern
children.help_text: Repeating overlay over the layer behind Inner (usually Module Outer). Does not add an Inner photo. Style is Dots, Grid, Lines (four orientations), or Custom SVG. Pattern Color percentage is strength. Pattern Background is an optional tint.
children.inline_help_text: Custom SVG code is at the bottom of the Content tab: Module Inner Pattern — Custom SVG Code.

children.name: style
children.label: Pattern Style
children.help_text: Repeating overlay. Lines include horizontal, vertical, and both diagonals. Custom SVG uses Color Mode (SVG hues vs Pattern Color) and Pattern Size (Repeat vs Fit overlay).
children.inline_help_text: Custom SVG code is at the bottom of the Content tab: Module Inner Pattern — Custom SVG Code.
choices: Lines — Top left to bottom right
Lines — Bottom left to top right

children.name: color_mode
children.label: Pattern Color Mode
children.help_text: Override paints the SVG silhouette with Pattern Color (hues in the markup are ignored). Use SVG colors keeps fills and gradients from the markup; Pattern Opacity is strength.

children.name: size_mode
children.label: Pattern Size
children.help_text: Always anchored middle center. Repeat tiles a 256px-wide copy from the center (Scale changes tile size). Fit overlay places one copy from the center (Scale zooms; 100% = inner width).

children.name: background
children.label: Pattern Background
children.help_text: Tint behind the pattern. Transparent by default so the layer behind Inner shows through (usually Module Outer).

children.name: pattern_color
children.label: Pattern Color
children.help_text: Pattern hue and strength. The color percentage is how visible the pattern is (100% = strongest; 0% = none). Start lower than Grain — a grid at 85% is very strong. Hidden when Custom SVG uses SVG colors.

children.name: opacity
children.label: Pattern Opacity
children.help_text: How strong the SVG artwork is. Hues stay as authored. 0 = none; 100 = full ink.

children.name: blend
children.label: Pattern Blend
children.help_text: How the pattern mixes with the layer below. Normal keeps Pattern Color honest. Overlay and Soft Light are film-on-photo. Multiply only darkens; Screen only lightens.

children.name: scale
children.label: Pattern Scale (%)
children.help_text: Repeat: tile size (lower = tighter). Fit overlay: zoom of the one copy (100% = inner width).

children.name: inner_border_override
children.label: Override Module Inner Border
children.help_text: Off (default): no Module Inner border stroke and no custom inner radius. On: use Module Inner Border Style / Weight / Color / Radius below. Style None keeps custom radius without a stroke. While Module Inner Background Options = Effect, the glass edge (Glass Border Color / Weight) is used instead of Style / Weight / Color. Radius still applies from this override.

children.name: inner_border_style
children.label: Module Inner Border Style
children.help_text: Custom border style when Override Module Inner Border is on. Use None to remove the custom inner border while keeping custom radius available. Hidden while Inner = Effect — use Glass Border Color / Weight instead.

children.name: inner_border_width
children.label: Module Inner Border Weight (px)
children.help_text: Custom border weight when Override Module Inner Border is on. Hidden while Inner = Effect — use Glass Border Weight instead.

children.name: inner_border_color
children.label: Module Inner Border Color
children.help_text: Custom border color and opacity when Override Module Inner Border is on. Hidden while Inner = Effect — use Glass Border Color instead.

children.name: inner_border_radius
children.label: Module Inner Border Radius (px)
children.help_text: Custom corner radius for the Module Inner layer when Override Module Inner Border is on. Still applies when Inner = Effect (glass edge does not replace radius).

children.name: content_colors
children.label: Content Colors
children.help_text: Content Area text and link colors. The Text Color also paints heading items in this grouping when their Color is Auto. Use when background is image/gradient/custom and theme defaults do not apply correctly.

children.name: text_color
children.label: Content Area Text Color
children.help_text: Theme or custom color for Content Area rich text and heading items in this grouping whose Color is Auto.
children.inline_help_text: Includes heading repeater items on Color Auto.

children.name: text_color_custom
children.label: Content Area Custom Text Color
children.help_text: Custom color for Content Area rich text and heading items in this grouping when Content Area Text Color is Custom.

children.name: link_context
children.label: Content Area Link Colors
children.help_text: Link color context for links in Content Area rich text and heading content in this grouping.

children.name: text_box_horizontal_margin
children.label: XL Side Spacing
children.help_text: Horizontal spacing from the container edge. Alignment controls which side(s). Use 0 for no gap.

children.name: text_box_horizontal_margin_lg
children.label: Desktop Side Spacing
children.help_text: Horizontal spacing from the container edge at this breakpoint. Use 0 to use the XL value.

children.name: text_box_horizontal_margin_md
children.label: Tablet Side Spacing
children.help_text: Horizontal spacing from the container edge at this breakpoint. Use 0 to use the Desktop value.

children.name: text_box_horizontal_margin_sm
children.label: Mobile Side Spacing
children.help_text: Horizontal spacing from the container edge at this breakpoint. Use 0 to use the Tablet value.
children.inline_help_text: Under 768px (SM/XS). Leave 0 to use Tablet value.

children.name: content_area_settings
children.label: Content Area Settings
children.help_text: Text alignment and spacing for the Content Area. Text Alignment also applies to heading repeater items in this grouping when Align is Auto. Desktop is 992px+ (LG and XL together). Spacing applies to the Content Area only.

children.name: text_align_default
children.label: Text Alignment (Desktop)
children.help_text: Horizontal alignment for Content Area rich text and for headings in this grouping when Align is Auto. Tablet and Mobile can override below.

children.name: override_md_text_align
children.label: Override Text Alignment (Tablet)
children.help_text: Enable to set a different text alignment for this breakpoint.

children.name: text_align_md
children.label: Text Alignment (Tablet)
children.help_text: Text alignment when Override Text Alignment (Tablet) is enabled.

children.name: override_sm_text_align
children.label: Override Text Alignment (Mobile)
children.help_text: Enable to set a different text alignment for this breakpoint.

children.name: text_align_sm
children.label: Text Alignment (Mobile)
children.help_text: Text alignment when Override Text Alignment (Mobile) is enabled.

children.name: text_box_padding
children.label: Text Box Padding
children.help_text: Controls padding for the text box content.

children.name: text_box_border_radius_override
children.label: Override Text Box Border Radius
children.help_text: When enabled, use the custom Text Box Corner Radius value below. When disabled, use the Global Border Radius from theme settings.

children.name: text_box_border_radius
children.label: Text Box Corner Radius
children.help_text: Rounds the corners of the text box. Set to 0 for no border radius. Only applies when Override Text Box Border Radius is enabled. Still applies when Text Box Background Options = Effect (glass edge does not replace radius).

children.name: text_box_background_option
children.label: Text Box Background Options
children.help_text: None = no text-box fill (the hero behind the box shows through — do not use Color at 0% for that). Color paints Text Box Background Color on this box. Effect does not use that color — Glass, Grain, or Pattern overlay the hero behind the text box (Inner, or Outer if Inner is Effect or None).

children.name: text_box_effect_type
children.label: Effect Type
children.help_text: Glass, Grain, or Pattern over the hero behind this text box. Does not add a text-box photo. For a solid or translucent box fill, switch Text Box Background Options back to Color.
children.inline_help_text: Overlays the hero behind this box. Does not add a photo.

children.name: text_box_glass
children.label: Glass
children.help_text: Frost on the text box. Same Glass controls as Module Inner. Corner radius stays on Override Text Box Border Radius.

children.name: blur
children.label: Glass Blur (px)
children.help_text: Backdrop blur amount. Keep modest for performance.

children.name: fill
children.label: Glass Fill
children.help_text: Translucent tint on the frosted text box. Opacity is the main how-glassy lever. Any hex — not only white.

children.name: saturate
children.label: Glass Saturate (%)
children.help_text: Color saturation of the blurred layer behind the glass. 100 is none; 160 is a typical frost.

children.name: border
children.label: Glass Border Color
children.help_text: Light edge on the frosted text box. Radius is unchanged — still Override Text Box Border Radius.

children.name: border_width
children.label: Glass Border Weight (px)
children.help_text: Width of the glass edge. 0 = no edge.

children.name: rim
children.label: Rim (px)
children.help_text: Thickness of the frosted frame around a solid face. 0 is today's full-panel glass (no face). 10 matches the animation POC. This is not the glass edge — that is Glass Border Weight.

children.name: face
children.label: Face fill
children.help_text: Solid panel inside the frost. Glass Fill tints the frame only. Hidden when Rim is 0.

children.name: text_box_grain
children.label: Grain
children.help_text: Film-grain speckle over the hero behind this text box (Inner, or Outer if Inner is Effect or transparent). Same Grain controls as Module Inner.

children.name: background
children.label: Grain Background
children.help_text: Tint behind the speckle. Transparent by default so the hero behind the text box shows through.

children.name: grain_color
children.label: Grain Color
children.help_text: Speckle hue and strength. The color percentage is how visible the grain is (100% = strongest; 0% = none).

children.name: blend
children.label: Grain Blend
children.help_text: How the speckle mixes with the layer below. Normal keeps Grain Color honest. Overlay and Soft Light are film-on-photo. Multiply only darkens; Screen only lightens.

children.name: density
children.label: Grain Density
children.help_text: How many specks per area. Speckle size stays with Grain Scale. Sparse = gappier; Dense = packed.

children.name: scale
children.label: Grain Scale (%)
children.help_text: Speckle size. 100 is default. Lower = finer (smaller specks); higher = coarser (larger specks).

children.name: rim
children.label: Rim (px)
children.help_text: Thickness of the grain frame around a solid face. 0 is today's full-panel grain (no face). Same as Glass Rim.

children.name: face
children.label: Face fill
children.help_text: Solid panel inside the grain. Grain Background tints the frame only. Hidden when Rim is 0.

children.name: text_box_pattern
children.label: Pattern
children.help_text: Repeating overlay over the hero behind this text box. Same Pattern controls as Module Inner.
children.inline_help_text: Custom SVG code is at the bottom of the Content tab: Text Box Pattern — Custom SVG Code.

children.name: style
children.label: Pattern Style
children.help_text: Repeating overlay. Lines include horizontal, vertical, and both diagonals. Custom SVG uses Color Mode (SVG hues vs Pattern Color) and Pattern Size (Repeat vs Fit overlay).
children.inline_help_text: Custom SVG code is at the bottom of the Content tab: Text Box Pattern — Custom SVG Code.
choices: Lines — Top left to bottom right
Lines — Bottom left to top right

children.name: color_mode
children.label: Pattern Color Mode
children.help_text: Override paints the SVG silhouette with Pattern Color (hues in the markup are ignored). Use SVG colors keeps fills and gradients from the markup; Pattern Opacity is strength.

children.name: size_mode
children.label: Pattern Size
children.help_text: Always anchored middle center. Repeat tiles a 256px-wide copy from the center (Scale changes tile size). Fit overlay places one copy from the center (Scale zooms; 100% = text box width).

children.name: background
children.label: Pattern Background
children.help_text: Tint behind the pattern. Transparent by default so the hero behind the text box shows through.

children.name: pattern_color
children.label: Pattern Color
children.help_text: Pattern hue and strength. The color percentage is how visible the pattern is (100% = strongest; 0% = none). Start lower than Grain — a grid at 85% is very strong. Hidden when Custom SVG uses SVG colors.

children.name: opacity
children.label: Pattern Opacity
children.help_text: How strong the SVG artwork is. Hues stay as authored. 0 = none; 100 = full ink.

children.name: blend
children.label: Pattern Blend
children.help_text: How the pattern mixes with the layer below. Normal keeps Pattern Color honest. Overlay and Soft Light are film-on-photo. Multiply only darkens; Screen only lightens.

children.name: scale
children.label: Pattern Scale (%)
children.help_text: Repeat: tile size (lower = tighter). Fit overlay: zoom of the one copy (100% = text box width).

children.name: rim
children.label: Rim (px)
children.help_text: Thickness of the pattern frame around a solid face. 0 is today's full-panel pattern (no face), including Custom SVG. Same as Glass Rim.

children.name: face
children.label: Face fill
children.help_text: Solid panel inside the pattern. Pattern Background tints the frame only. Hidden when Rim is 0.

children.name: text_box_background_color
children.label: Text Box Background Color
children.help_text: Fill color for the text box when Text Box Background Options is Color. Hidden when None or Effect is on — None has no fill; Effect uses Glass Fill, Grain Background, or Pattern Background instead.

children.name: text_box_horizontal_align
children.label: Text Box Horizontal Alignment
children.help_text: Controls the horizontal position of the text box within the hero container.

children.name: heading_settings
children.label: Headings
children.help_text: Typography options for the heading repeater.

children.name: heading_text_wrap
children.label: Heading text wrap
children.help_text: How heading lines wrap. Balance evens line lengths; Auto uses browser default. Theme default is Balance.
